LanguageData.LP_SecondWind.label: second wind
LanguageData.LP_SecondWind.description: Steady your breath and continuously heal your own injuries over 600 ticks, totaling 20 × martial power, bleeding wounds first. Power uses the higher of martial power and marksman power. Fighter level 1.
LanguageData.LP_Charge.label: charge
LanguageData.LP_Charge.description: Charge at an enemy within 8 cells: leap next to it and immediately resolve a melee hit with your current weapon on landing (guaranteed hit, damage ×(1 + 0.3 × martial power)); targets of body size 1 or less are knocked down (stunned 1 second). Fighter level 1.
LanguageData.LP_SteadyAim.label: steady aim
LanguageData.LP_SteadyAim.description: Hunker down to aim: for 15 seconds shooting warmup ×0.5, ranged hit ×1.15, movement ×0.5. Fighter level 1 (Shooting branch).
LanguageData.LP_BattleCry.label: war cry
LanguageData.LP_BattleCry.description: A roar: enemies within radius 4 × martial power are shaken for 5 seconds × martial power: movement ×0.7, lower hit chance. Power uses the higher of martial power and marksman power. Fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_SuppressingFire.label: suppressing fire
LanguageData.LP_SuppressingFire.description: Pour fire onto an area: fire 6 rounds from your current weapon in rapid succession (one every 0.1 seconds, landing on random cells within radius 3 of the target point, damage ×0.5); enemies in the area are suppressed for 6 seconds: movement ×0.6, ranged hit ×0.75. Range = current weapon range; requires a ranged weapon. Fighter level 3 (Shooting branch).
LanguageData.LP_Trip.label: trip attack
LanguageData.LP_Trip.description: Trip an adjacent target: stunned for 1.5 seconds × martial power and knocked back 1 cell; targets of body size 2+ are only shaken, not knocked back. Fighter level 5.
LanguageData.LP_ActionSurge.label: action surge
LanguageData.LP_ActionSurge.description: For 10 seconds × martial power, melee cooldown ×0.6, shooting cooldown ×0.6, movement ×1.3. Cooldown 6 hours. Fighter level 5.
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.label: weapon specialization
LanguageData.LP_WeaponMastery.description: For 2 hours × martial power, melee damage ×1.24 to ×1.45 (tiered by martial power); ranged weapon damage also uses the same tier multiplier. Cooldown 1 hour. Fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_Indomitable.label: indomitable
LanguageData.LP_Indomitable.description: For 1 hour × martial power, feels no pain, cannot be downed by pain, immune to stuns, mental break threshold -15%. Cooldown 6 hours. Fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_PrecisionShot.label: precise shot
LanguageData.LP_PrecisionShot.description: Instantly fire one bullet from your current weapon at an enemy: guaranteed hit, damage ×(1.5 + 0.5 × marksman power), armor penetration +30%. When drafted there is an extra button to switch modes: Vital (only the above) / Leg (damage ×0.7, target movement ×0.5 for 10 seconds) / Hand (damage ×0.5, a chance to knock the weapon away, success based on Dexterity and marksman power; hover the mode button to see the formula). Range = current weapon range; requires a ranged weapon. Fighter level 7 (Shooting branch).
LanguageData.LP_DisarmingStrike.label: disarming strike
LanguageData.LP_DisarmingStrike.description: Resolve a melee hit on an adjacent enemy, then try to knock its weapon away (landing 2 cells off). Success = 50% + 10% × (your Strength modifier + proficiency bonus - the target's) + 20% × (martial power - 1), limited to 15%-90%; halved again for body size 2+. A side without an adventurer level counts as modifier 0, proficiency +2. Mechanoids, animals and the unarmed only take the hit. Fighter level 10.
LanguageData.LP_Whirlwind.label: whirlwind attack
LanguageData.LP_Whirlwind.description: Resolve your current melee weapon's damage once against every adjacent enemy (guaranteed hit, damage × martial power; melee damage factor, weapon quality and Isekai refinement / Strength bonuses all count). Fighter level 10.
LanguageData.LP_RapidFire.label: rapid shot
LanguageData.LP_RapidFire.description: For 10 seconds × marksman power, shooting cooldown ×0.5; burst weapons fire 1 extra shot per burst. Cooldown 2 hours. Fighter level 10 (Shooting branch).
LanguageData.LP_GuardStance.label: guardian stance
LanguageData.LP_GuardStance.description: For 30 seconds × martial power, armor +16% to +30% (tiered by martial power), movement ×0.7; 30% of damage taken by allies within radius 3 is transferred to yourself. Cooldown 2 hours. Fighter level 13.
LanguageData.LP_SurgeOfBattle.label: renewed fighting spirit
LanguageData.LP_SurgeOfBattle.description: For 20 seconds melee cooldown ×0.5, melee damage ×1.5, immune to stuns; during it every melee kill instantly resets all fighter maneuvers. Cooldown 1 day. Fighter level 15, and Melee 15.
LanguageData.LP_DeadEye.label: eye of death
LanguageData.LP_DeadEye.description: For 20 seconds ranged attacks always hit and ignore cover, shooting damage ×1.5; during it every enemy shot dead instantly resets all fighter maneuvers. Cooldown 1 day. Fighter level 15, and Shooting 15.
LanguageData.LP_MartialArts.label: martial arts
LanguageData.LP_MartialArts.description: Passive: unarmed (or with a quarterstaff), melee damage ×(1 + 0.5 × martial power), melee cooldown ×0.85; when not wearing clothing with sharp armor ≥ 40%, melee dodge +10% × martial power. Fists and kicks use vanilla melee resolution; Isekai's Strength and weapon mastery apply as usual. Monk level 1.
LanguageData.LP_FlurryOfBlows.label: flurry of blows
LanguageData.LP_FlurryOfBlows.description: Throw 2 punches at an adjacent target (3 at martial power ≥ 125%), each a full melee resolution (guaranteed hit). Monk level 1.
LanguageData.LP_DeflectMissiles.label: deflect missiles
LanguageData.LP_DeflectMissiles.description: For 30 seconds × martial power: each ranged attack's damage is reduced by 10 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity); reduced to 0, the whole shot is deflected. Monk level 3.
LanguageData.LP_StunningStrike.label: stunning strike
LanguageData.LP_StunningStrike.description: A punch that shocks the target with ki: stunned for 2 seconds × martial power (× psychic sensitivity; halved for body size 2+); works on mechanoids too. Monk level 5.
LanguageData.LP_StepOfTheWind.label: step of the wind
LanguageData.LP_StepOfTheWind.description: For 20 seconds × martial power: movement ×1.6, melee dodge +20%. Monk level 7.
LanguageData.LP_OpenHand.label: open hand technique
LanguageData.LP_OpenHand.description: A punch knocks an adjacent target back 3 cells (1 cell for body size 2+) and down for 1 second; other enemies next to the landing spot each take 6 × martial power blunt damage. Monk level 7.
LanguageData.LP_DiamondSoul.label: diamond body
LanguageData.LP_DiamondSoul.description: Instantly heal 20 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) and cure food poisoning or clear 20% of toxic buildup; then for 1 hour × martial power, damage taken ×0.7, immune to stuns, mental break threshold -10%. Monk level 10.
LanguageData.LP_QuiveringPalm.label: quivering palm
LanguageData.LP_QuiveringPalm.description: A punch plants quivering ki inside the target that bursts after 3 seconds: the torso takes 40 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) blunt damage (ignoring half the armor); halved against giants or body size 3+. Monk level 13.
LanguageData.LP_EmptyBody.label: empty body
LanguageData.LP_EmptyBody.description: For 30 seconds × martial power: invisible (enemies cannot target), damage taken ×0.5, heals 1 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) per second. Monk level 15, and Melee 15.
LanguageData.LP_DivineSmite.label: divine smite
LanguageData.LP_DivineSmite.description: Within 10 seconds, the next melee hit deals an extra 10 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage, doubled against undead, fiends and mind flayers. The weapon hit resolves as usual (Isekai bonuses apply). Paladin level 1.
LanguageData.LP_LayOnHands.label: lay on hands
LanguageData.LP_LayOnHands.description: Touch an ally (or yourself) to heal 25 × divine power (× psychic sensitivity); with no wounds, instead cure food poisoning or clear 30% of toxic buildup. Paladin level 1.
LanguageData.LP_VowOfEnmity.label: vow of enmity
LanguageData.LP_VowOfEnmity.description: Mark one enemy for 1 day: all damage the caster deals to it ×(1 + 0.25 × martial power); when it dies the caster gets mood +5 (vow fulfilled). Paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AuraOfProtection.label: aura of protection
LanguageData.LP_AuraOfProtection.description: Passive: allies within radius 5 (including yourself) take damage ×(1 - 0.1 × divine power) (minimum ×0.8), mental break threshold -5%. Multiple paladins don't stack; the strongest applies. Paladin level 5.
LanguageData.LP_SacredWeapon.label: sacred weapon
LanguageData.LP_SacredWeapon.description: For 1 hour × martial power: every melee hit adds 4 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage (doubled against undead, fiends and mind flayers). Paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_AuraOfCourage.label: aura of courage
LanguageData.LP_AuraOfCourage.description: Passive: allies within radius 5 do not panic and flee, and are freed from "shaken" at once. Paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_Intercept.label: swap guard
LanguageData.LP_Intercept.description: Instantly swap places with an ally within 12 × martial power cells; they get "protected" for 10 seconds: damage taken ×0.5. Paladin level 10.
LanguageData.LP_DispelEvil.label: banish evil
LanguageData.LP_DispelEvil.description: Hostile undead, fiends and mind flayers within radius 5 × divine power each take 30 × divine power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage and are stunned for 2 seconds; hostile summons are dispelled outright. Paladin level 13.
LanguageData.LP_HolyAvatar.label: holy avatar
LanguageData.LP_HolyAvatar.description: For 30 seconds × martial power: enemies within radius 6 take 5 × martial power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage per second (doubled against undead and fiends), allies heal 40% of that per second; you are immune to stuns and panic. Paladin level 15, and Melee 15.
